name: web.dev
body: Preloaded HSTS, a nonce-based content security policy, and Organization and WebSite JSON-LD. But the home page also carries an Article block whose headline is an empty string, with no author or date.
lesson: Validate structured data in CI. An item with empty required fields is noise that search may ignore.
summary: web.dev scores 80 out of 100 (B). 2 checks fail now, 18 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: 4 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 4 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /discover. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 14 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: / Article lacks author, datePublished, /html Article lacks author, datePublished, /css Article lacks author, datePublished and 11 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: 12 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /html, /css, /javascript, /performance and 8 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: 14 pages do not have exactly one h1
fix.fix: Give each page one h1 that names it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Language alternates point at each other
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
